text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis. Given the chronic progressive dyspnea, non-productive cough, 6-week duration, heavy smoking history, and chest X-ray showing bilateral interstitial markings without nodules or acute infection, the most likely diagnosis is pulmonary fibrosis.
